text_markup: The Runner can use the [trash] ability on {card:Abagnale} during an encounter with a {subtype:code gate}. They can only use the interface ability on {card:Abagnale} during an encounter with a {subtype:code gate} that {card:Abagnale} has sufficient strength to interface with.
text_plain: The Runner can use the {trash} ability on Abagnale during an encounter with a code gate. They can only use the interface ability on Abagnale during an encounter with a code gate that Abagnale has sufficient strength to interface with.
